title: 第7章 双甲上评分他有木雕作品第8章 鬼神空饰血凰神女诛厉鬼像
slug: 刻刀一把雕出天上白玉京
content_zh:
对于雕工技艺，倪嫣很自信，在唐氏雕工铺的诸多学徒中，基本上无人比的过她。
她也从来没有与唐氏雕工铺的学徒比过。
因为不需要。
毕竟，她的天赋，以及自身所得获的雕工传承，便非是这些学徒们能比拟的。
这一次的雕师考核，她只是来走一个过场罢了。
可哪怕只是走过场，倪嫣也相信以自己的技艺，随便耍耍都能拿下第一名。
然而，第一场雕工考核，居然就有人先她一步完成？
虽然提前完成不算什么，并不意味着木雕作品就一定是好的。
但这第一场雕工考核的时间是两个时辰，在倪嫣的认知中，她觉得大部分学徒都来不及在规定时间内完成雕刻。
所以……这抢先她一步完成雕刻的，是谁？
倪嫣看了过去，便看到了一位面容清秀，眉宇间带着几分坚毅的少年。
这少年……好像叫做李浪吧？
倪嫣歪了下脑袋，从记忆中搜刮一番，终于是想到了少年的名字。
她有些印象，但是并不多……
因为这个李浪，好像并未与鬼神产生共鸣，觉醒鬼神纹。
这一刻，诸多学徒们也被二人一前一后的呼喊声给打断了思路，一个个跟见鬼似的看了过来。
唐宇满是肥肉的脸上一阵颤抖，微微扭曲。
李浪就好了？
艹！
他怎么能这么快！

一定是乱来了，自暴自弃，胡乱雕刻一通吧？
两个时辰，哪怕是小件木雕，也不是那么容易完成的！
考核学徒们彼此之间离的并不算远，倪嫣戴着面纱，两个姣好的眸子望来，便看到了李浪那雕刻完成，摆在桌子上的木雕“鬼婴”
这一看，倪嫣眼眸顿时微微亮起。
在李浪喊出完成雕刻的话语后，唐花柳等人目光也投射而来。
周执事最先按捺不住，率先来到李浪的桌案前，拿捏起了那巴掌大的木雕像。
“果然是‘九曲鳞刻’技艺，掌握的虽然有些生涩，但至少是入门了，连‘拔鳞技’都展现出来。”
周执事笑了起来。
“老叶，你看来没少给这小子开小灶啊。”
唐花柳和叶大师也相继走来，叶大师负手而行，身上长衫微摆，他淡淡一笑：“话可别乱说，我从来不给人开小灶，他自己悟的。”
“我这人最讲究公平，才不会背地里搞小动作。”
话语声音不大，却是意有所指，让凑过来的唐老三面色微微难看，叶大师的话语，很显然是在点他。
叶大师也没有多言，拿过木雕鬼婴，细细打量起来。
眼中顿时闪烁过一抹惊艳之色！
content_en:
Ni Yan is very confident in her carving skills. Among the many apprentices in Tang's Carving Shop, basically no one can compare with her.
She has never competed with the apprentices of Tang's Carving Shop.
Because it's not needed.
After all, her talent and the carving inheritance she received were beyond the reach of these apprentices.
This time in the carver assessment, she was just going through the motions.
But even if she is just going through the motions, Ni Yan believes that with her own skills, she can win first place in any show.
However, someone actually finished the first carving test before her?
Although finishing ahead of schedule is nothing, it does not mean that the wood carving work must be good.
But the first carving assessment lasted for two hours. From Ni Yan's understanding, she felt that most of the apprentices would not be able to complete the carving within the specified time.
So... who was the one who finished the carving before her?
Ni Yan looked over and saw a young man with a delicate face and a hint of determination between his brows.
This boy... seems to be called Li Lang, right?
Ni Yan tilted her head, searched through her memory, and finally thought of the boy's name.
She had some impression, but not much...
Because this Li Lang didn't seem to resonate with the ghosts and gods and awaken the ghosts and gods.
At this moment, many apprentices were interrupted by the shouts of the two men, and they all looked over as if they had seen a ghost.
Tang Yu's fat face trembled and twisted slightly.
Will Li Lang be fine?
grass!
How could he be so fast!
He must have messed up, given up on himself, and made random carvings, right?
Even a small wood carving is not that easy to complete in two hours!
The assessment apprentices were not too far away from each other. Ni Yan, wearing a veil, looked with two beautiful eyes and saw Li Lang's finished wood carving "Ghost Baby" placed on the table.
At this sight, Ni Yan's eyes suddenly lit up slightly.
After Li Lang shouted the words to complete the carving, Tang Hualiu and others also looked at him.
Deacon Zhou couldn't hold himself any longer. He came to Li Lang's desk first and picked up the palm-sized wooden statue.
"As expected, it's the 'Nine Curved Scale Carving' technique. Although it's a bit awkward to master, it's at least basic. Even the 'Scale Pulling Technique' has been demonstrated."
Deacon Zhou laughed.
"Old Ye, it seems that you have given this boy a lot of trouble."
Tang Hualiu and Master Ye also came one after another. Master Ye walked with his hands behind his back, his long robe swaying slightly, and he smiled lightly: "Don't talk nonsense, I never make mistakes for others, he realized it by himself."
"I'm a very fair person, so I won't do anything behind the scenes."
The words were not loud, but they were meaningful. Tang Laosan, who was leaning over, looked slightly ugly. Master Ye's words were obviously aimed at him.
Master Ye didn't say much. He took the wooden ghost baby and looked at it carefully.
A flash of surprise suddenly flashed in his eyes!
